Template_Usage_Guidelines:
GENERAL GUIDELINES FOR ALL BLOG POST TEMPLATES:

UNIVERSAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Minimum word count: 800-1,000 words (some templates like Pillar require 2,000-5,000+)
- Visuals: Include at least 1-2 relevant images, charts, infographics, or videos
- SEO: Optimize titles (60 characters or less), include targeted keywords
- Sources: Properly cite and backlink all sources and external references
- Quality: Always proofread and spell check before publishing
- Originality: Add unique perspective, personal insight, or original examples to distinguish from generic AI-generated content

STANDOUT FROM AI-GENERATED CONTENT:
- Incorporate YOUR expertise, experiences, and insights
- Include specific personal examples and anecdotes
- Add data from YOUR research or experiences
- Share YOUR unique perspective or opinion
- Include case studies from YOUR work
- Provide industry-specific insights only YOU would know
- Use YOUR brand voice and tone consistently

STRUCTURE BEST PRACTICES:
- Start with compelling introduction (100-200 words typically)
- Use clear subheadings for SEO and readability
- Include specific, actionable advice
- Provide real examples and case studies
- End with strong, relevant call-to-action
- Link to related content or resources

SEO OPTIMIZATION:
- Title contains target keyword, under 60 characters
- Include keyword in introduction naturally
- Use keyword in at least one subheading
- Optimize for featured snippets where applicable (especially "What Is" and "How To" posts)
- Add alt-text to all images with relevant keywords
- Include internal and external links

CONTENT MANAGEMENT:
- Upload to your CMS platform (consider HubSpot's free CMS)
- Schedule appropriately for seasonal/timely content
- Update regularly for evergreen content
- Promote across social media channels
- Repurpose into other formats (videos, infographics, social posts)

CALL-TO-ACTION OPTIONS:
- Subscribe to blog/newsletter
- Download related resources (guides, templates, checklists)
- Try product/service featured
- Schedule consultation or demo
- Share post or leave comments
- Explore related content
- Contact team for support

VISUAL REQUIREMENTS BY TYPE:
- Infographic posts: High-quality infographic with alt-text
- How-to/Tutorial: Screenshots, diagrams, or step-by-step visuals
- Data-driven/Research: Charts, graphs, data visualizations
- Case Study: Before/after images, metrics charts, testimonials
- Comparison: Comparison tables or charts
- All others: At least 1-2 relevant images, photos, or graphics

MAINTAINING AUTHENTICITY:
- Share personal stories and experiences
- Be honest about challenges and limitations
- Provide unique insights from your perspective
- Include real examples from your work
- Use conversational, genuine tone
- Address counterarguments thoughtfully
- Acknowledge uncertainties where appropriate
